# Laspii
Laspii are a species of bipedal slimes. Biologically they are identical to their feral counterparts, with the capability for higher thought as the only distinguishing factor.
## Racial Features - They breathe nitrogen. - They exhale nitrous oxide and are unaffected by it. - Their "blood" is made out of bright green slime and cannot be metabolised from blood, it is also highly nutricious. - They are able to inject slime anywhere into their body to regenerate blood level. - They [color=#ffa500]take significant damage if they are sprayed or splashed with water[/color]. - Thanks to their unique biology, they [color=#1e90ff]can process 6 reagents at the same time instead of just 2[/color]. - They have an [color=#1e90ff][bold]internal 2x3 storage inventory[/bold][/color] inside of their slime membrane. - Their body [color=#1e90ff]regenerates from wounds until it reaches 65 damage, and does so at twice the speed[/color] of other humanoids. - Due to their anatomy they [color=#1e90ff]can reattach any of their lost limbs[/color]. - They take [color=#1e90ff]80% less asphyxiation damage[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]9% more pressure damage[/color]. - Their body is more resistant to blunt force trauma but not much else, taking [color=#1e90ff]40% less blunt damage[/color] while taking [color=#ffa500]20% more damage of both slash damage and pierce damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]30% more cold damage[/color]. - Due to having their core inside their torso, they [color=#1e90ff]can survive losing their head[/color] but will be unable to speak or see without it. - They can tell how thirsty others are. - They [color=#ffa500]lack most usual organs[/color], only having a "heart", core and "lungs" - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Bubblish The Laspii language, known as Bubblish, is composed of bubbling sounds and pops. It is known to be utterly impossible to speak without mechanical help and is spoken by all slimes, even the non sentient ones.
## Age and Names Laspii do not age in the traditional sense as they do not reach adulthood at a specific age nor do they die of old age, instead they simply gain sentience one day and may lose it with age. Similarly, they lack naming conventions. Most often a Laspii choses their own name upon gaining sentience in accordance to the local naming conventions.
